_readme: Hand-read at 2x on 10 px grids of each key's composite (tools/gen/rig-landmarks.py composite) by the v3.1 runtime pass, 2026-09-22. _R = her right = the viewer's LEFT (green eye); _L = her left (blue eye). A feature hidden by the turn sits on the silhouette where it disappears, so left-to-right order never crosses. hairSide_* are measured, not typed: the head layers' alpha extremes on row y 180 (tools/gen/rig-turns.py wire). turn-r45 / turn-r85 are mirrors (x -> 990 - x, _R and _L swapped). On a turned key the far cheek_R / jaw_R sit ON the far face contour (its ink line), so that contour maps onto the frontal's cheek edge instead of being smeared across the cheek; the 3/4 key's noseTip is taken at the base of the nose above the far mouth corner (its highlight sits out on the far contour, past that corner, and a landmark there would fold the mesh).

hairSideFixed._readme: v3.3 (tools/gen/rig-turns.py wire): the turn keys keep the hair-side points measured on the v3.2 heads. The v3.3 heads run the back of the head past the frame (x > 990 unmirrored), so a re-measured silhouette would be the back of the skull, not the side of the hair the frontal's point names, and would stretch the frontal across a turn.

_pinsReadme: v3.3: four side pins just past the canvas (x -40 and 872, y 330 and 600) hold the frame's edges while the face turns and sways; without them the frontal's side hair, which the approved plate cuts at x 831, was pulled 20 px off the border at -20 degrees and the edge smeared
